title: Redo Replacement Picking (384)
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Specify worklist CSV
steps.instruction:
Create a worklist CSV file with the columns: Number of Redo, pos, TB_RCK_1, pos, MTP_1, disposal_vol, transfer_vol, TUBE BAR, PLATE BAR. Populate it exactly as shown:
```
Number of Redo,pos,TB_RCK_1,pos,MTP_1,disposal_vol,transfer_vol,TUBE BAR,PLATE BAR
1,1,200,200
2,135,200,200
3,2,150,200
4,90,100,100
5,84
6,262
7,242
8,218
9,219
```

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT App interface, input any required protocol parameters as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package, then unzip it if necessary to obtain the .py file.

steps.title: Add custom labware
steps.instruction: Upload any custom labware JSON files to the OT App by selecting More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and choosing the .json files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to the Protocol tab and upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical deck on the robot according to the provided deck map for this protocol.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette as described in the calibration support articles.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to start the Redo Replacement Picking protocol.
